※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
心里正想着事情，病房门再次被人敲响，华十二以为还是护士，说了一声：“进。”
结果推门进来的是一对看上去四十多岁的男女。
这对男女穿着看上去价值不菲，当看到华十二的时候，那女人情绪就有些激动，红着眼睛走到病床旁，屈膝直接就跪了下来：
“小兄弟你就是我们家的大恩人，我给你磕头了。”
华十二心里对这对男女的身份已经有了一些猜测，连忙下床将女人扶了起来。
还没等他开口寻问，那中年男人也快步走到跟前，感激的道：
“太好了，小兄弟你终于醒了，你没事就好.”
“你们是那孩子的父母？”
这对男女连连点头，同时自我介绍起来，男人叫王力，女人叫李丹，正是华十二救下那孩子的父母。
华十二让两人坐下，有什么事情慢慢说。
王力两口子坐下之后，李丹一把鼻涕一把泪的说了起来。
他们这两口子早年忙于事业，等到快到四十才要了这么一个独生儿子，平时捧在手里怕摔了，含在嘴里怕化了，宝贝的不要不要的。
今天妻子李丹带着儿子上街，儿子跑跑跳跳的在前面走，当妈的在后面一边跟着一边看手机，本以为只要孩子走在人行道上就不会有事，没想到竟然会有汽车冲过来。
用他们夫妻的话来讲这一次要是儿子有什么好歹，夫妻两个恐怕直接就能疯了。
所以他们对华十二也是百分之百发自真心的感激。
李丹说着眼泪就止不住的流，后悔之意溢于言表，一个劲儿的说以后和儿子在一起的时候再也不摆弄手机了。
华十二本来就惦记那孩子的安危呢，连忙寻问孩子受没受伤。

说起这个，王力两口子对华十二更加感激起来。
王力告诉华十二，因为有了他的保护，所以孩子并没有受什么严重的伤，只是受了一些惊吓。
孩子母亲李丹捂着心口说道：“当时小兄弟你直接就被撞飞了，我眼前一黑差点晕倒，后来送到医院之后，经过检查说你和孩子都没受伤，我还不相信，以为他们是在安慰我，没想到真的发生了奇迹！”
王力在一旁心有余悸的道：“小兄弟是好人有好报，咱们儿子都是托了小兄弟福啊！”
李丹闻言连连点头，他们两口子可不是忽悠，王力在交警那里已经看过肇事车的行车记录仪了，当时华十二抱着那孩子被撞飞了好几米，直接撞在路边门面的落地玻璃上。
连那么厚的玻璃都撞碎了，人一点事儿没有，这不是奇迹又是什么。
不过这两口子说了一件事情，让华十二都有些惊疑不定。
据李丹说，华十二被送进医院之后，一开始的心率加快，血压降低，做过ct与核磁共振之后，被诊断为内脏破裂，需要立刻手术。
当时人都被推进手术室了，可血压、心跳忽然就恢复了正常，最后确定是检查的时候，机器出现了故障，才会给出内脏破裂的诊断，而之前产生的症状应该是应激反应。
李丹说完，王力就笑了：“我说就因为小兄弟是有福之人，都进手术室了还能转危为安，这不是有福是什么，咱儿子这次是遇到贵人了！”
华十二心中惊疑不定，却也有些后怕，好家伙，都进手术室了，这是好悬没给剖了啊。

Just as he was thinking about things, there was another knock on the ward door. Hua Twelve thought it was still a nurse and said, "Come in."
As a result, a man and a woman who looked to be in their forties came in through the door.
The clothes of this man and woman looked valuable. When she saw Hua Twelve, the woman became a little excited. She walked to the hospital bed with red eyes and knelt down directly:
"Little brother, you are the great benefactor of our family. I kowtow to you."
Hua Twelve already had some guesses about the identity of the man and woman, so he quickly got out of bed and helped the woman up.
Before he could ask, the middle-aged man quickly walked up to him and said gratefully:
"That's great, little brother, you finally woke up. I hope you're fine."
"Are you the child's parents?"
The man and woman nodded repeatedly and introduced themselves at the same time. The man's name was Wang Li and the woman's name was Li Dan. They were the parents of the child whom Hua Twelve saved.
Hua Twelve asked the two of them to sit down and talk about something slowly.
After Wang Li and his wife sat down, Li Dan started talking with runny nose and tears.
The two of them were busy with their careers in the early years, and they waited until they were almost forty before they had such an only son. They usually held it in their hands for fear of falling, and held it in their mouths for fear of melting. They didn't want to let go of the baby.
Today, my wife Li Dan took her son to the street. The son was running and jumping in front, and the mother was following behind while looking at her mobile phone. She thought that as long as the child walked on the sidewalk, nothing would happen, but she didn't expect that a car would rush towards her.
In the words of the couple, if their son did anything good this time, the couple would probably go crazy.
Therefore, they are also 100% sincerely grateful to Hua Twelve.
Li Dan couldn't stop crying as he spoke. His regret was palpable, and he kept saying that he would never play with his cell phone again when he was with his son.
Hua Twelve was already concerned about the child's safety, so he quickly asked if the child was injured.
Speaking of this, Wang Li and his wife became even more grateful to Hua Twelve.
Wang Li told Hua Twelve that because of his protection, the child was not seriously injured, but only a little frightened.
The mother of the child, Li Dan, covered her heart and said, "Little brother, you were knocked away. I almost fainted when my eyesight went dark. Later, after I was sent to the hospital, after examination, it was said that you and the child were not injured. I still didn't believe it. I thought they were trying to comfort me. I didn't expect a miracle to happen!"
Wang Li said with lingering fear on the side: "Little brother is a good person and will be rewarded well. Our son is all thanks to little brother!"
Li Dan nodded repeatedly after hearing this. They were not fooling around. Wang Li had already seen the driving recorder of the car involved in the accident at the traffic police. At that time, Hua Twelve was carrying the child and was knocked several meters away, directly hitting the floor-to-ceiling glass of the roadside facade.
Even the thick glass was shattered, but no one was harmed at all. This is nothing but a miracle.
However, the two couples said something that made Hua Twelve a little surprised.
According to Li Dan, after Hua Twelve was sent to the hospital, his heart rate increased and his blood pressure dropped at first. After undergoing CT and MRI, he was diagnosed with visceral rupture and needed immediate surgery.
At that time, everyone was pushed into the operating room, but the blood pressure and heartbeat suddenly returned to normal. It was finally determined that the machine malfunctioned during the examination, and the diagnosis of visceral rupture was given, and the previous symptoms should be stress reactions.
After Li Dan finished speaking, Wang Li smiled: "I said it's just because my little brother is a blessed person. Even after he was in the operating room, he was able to turn things around. This is not a blessing. Our son has met a noble person this time!"
Hua Twelve was shocked and confused, butI'm also a little scared. My dear, I'm already in the operating room. It's almost like I'm about to be dissected.
